0.original: Ketenramm has much to discuss with you.

48.original: Speak with Jeffroy when yer ready to make for the North Horn. We can talk more when we get to the base camp.

49.original: I see that my initial assessment of “<hex:021A020203>un<hex:021A020103>familiar” still stands. What in the world is that irksome little rascal thinking?

50.original: You were guided to this isle...

51.original: Hemmed in by imposing peaks on all sides... This region appears to be isolated from the rest of the island.

52.original: What will you see in these strange lands?

53.original: Our goals here are twofold: uncover the truth of the Occult Crescent and ensure the crew makes it home in one piece.

54.original: Now, I reckon findin' the isle's architect is key to achievin' both. Given that he's probably holed up in the Tower of Magic, findin' a way in should be our first order of business.

55.original: Accordin' to our scouts, the fiends in this part of the island are a damn sight tougher than the beasties we've encountered so far. If ye find yerself strugglin', ye'd best head back to the South Horn for a spot of trainin'.

56.original: I should also mention that the surveyors have turned up some interestin' new trinkets. Speak with the crew if that tickles yer fancy.

57.original: Oh, and don't forget to attune with the camp's aetheryte while yer here.

58.original: My friend, I wish to have a quick word with you. Let me know once you've completed your preparations.

59.original: Ye'd best get prepared. There's no tellin' what's waitin' for us outside the camp.

60.original: This aetheryte won't provide passage to the South Horn...

61.original: I was hoping we could discuss the soul shards─you know, those crystalline records of martial methods conceived by the twelve city-states of eld.

62.original: As you no doubt recall, I posited they would only function upon the isle itself. Was my hypothesis correct?

63.original: Part of me had wondered whether you in particular might be able to wield the shards' power beyond the ward. Evidently not...

64.original: In truth, I've also been pondering the reason you were summoned here in the first place.

65.original: If the voice you heard belongs to the island's architect, then seeking him out in the Tower of Magic ought to provide answers on that front too.

67.original: In other words, the time has come to venture forth once more!
